title: ICANN Domain Lookup Shows Registration Data and Its Limits

cover.h2: Shows Registration Data and Its Limits
cover.subtitle: Read the fields. Keep the evidence bounded.

sections.name: 01-search
sections.heading: A precise search starts with the registered domain

sections.name: 02-fields
sections.heading: Registration fields answer different operational questions

sections.name: 04-evidence
sections.heading: A useful lookup report states the evidence gaps
